title: Safe segment endpoint avoids forbidden states
statement: For a multi-tape machine, a set $F$ of forbidden states, a predicate $P$ on work-tape head positions, configurations $a,b$, and a natural number $t$, if the run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time strictly before $t$, satisfies $P$ at every time from $0$ through $t$, and $b$'s state is outside $F$, then $b$'s state is outside $F$.
hypotheses_covered: A safe segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $t$
